verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Sandboxes is built to run untrusted code in isolated environments, with each sandbox in its own VM or container and a full Linux environment (docs-34, docs-38, docs-50). It also lets you intercept outbound HTTP through Workers (docs-23), so agents can test in a throwaway space walled off from production systems. However, sandboxes can be wired to KV, R2 and mounted buckets (docs-7, docs-20), and one community user describes outbound network control as all-or-nothing (comm-2), so keeping production data out depends on how you configure them. Missing for 10: documented guidance on scoping or keeping production bindings and data away from test sandboxes, fine-grained egress controls, and independent hands-on confirmation of the isolation guarantees.
